name: Yuming
bio: Wields polearm and assault rifle, empowering his Plunge Attack for huge single hits. Doubles as a top-tier enabler and sub-DPS, buffing the team and dealing heavy off-field damage — his ultimate summons the dragon Xuanjiao and grants hit-stun immunity.

skills.name: Precipitous Thunderfall
skills.desc: Yuming leaps into the air and replaces the next Plunging Attack with [Starlight Descent]. Using this skill in [Xuanjiao Manifest] state grants Yuming 1 [Reverse Scale]. When the amount of [Reverse Scale] reaches its maximum, [Starlight Descent] is enhanced to [Starstorm Descent].

skills.name: Grimscales
skills.desc: Deals Electro Damage to enemies in front and enters [Xuanjiao Manifest] state.

skills.name: Soaring Sky-High
skills.desc: When dealing Skill DMG, apply 1 stack of [Battle Frenzy] to enemies — decreases their Electro Resistance (up to 3 stacks).

skills.name: Gallop Northwestward
skills.desc: [Only effective when deployed as a Combat Partner] Increases Morale for you and Electro teammates within range.
